- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yudofu is described as a Kyoto specialty, often served with dipping sauces.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yudofu atmosphere is cozy and casual, with a price range of ¥1,000 - ¥3,000 per person (approx. $9 - $28 USD).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended food exploration areas include Gion, Ponto-cho, Nishiki Market, Kiyamachi, and Sanjo.
- [PREFERENCE] User is particularly interested in trying Kaiseki and Yudofu.
